snippet.title: P-47 II MD - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
In 1990, Jaleco was developing their first game for MD under the name "P-47 II: The Freedom Star" which was a port of their arcade his "P-47: The Phantom Fighter".  It was canceled late in development and has long stayed hidden ever since.  Now 35 years later, this mysterious game resurfaces with exciting gameplay challenging new players and veterans alike.  Strap into your jump seats - you won't want to miss this one!
